errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the right y-axis, which corresponds to the "新闻媒体每日报道数目" (Number of daily news media reports) and has a scale from 0 to 6000.
The description completely omits the blue line chart, which represents the "有关covid-19新闻数量" (Number of covid-19 related news). This is one of the two main data series in the chart.

errors.text_span: 最短的柱子的高度约为200000
errors.evidence: The description states the height of the shortest bars is approximately 200,000. However, the figure shows that the shortest bars have a value of approximately 400,000.

errors.text_span: 而最高的柱子则达到近1800000
errors.evidence: The description claims the highest bar reaches nearly 1,800,000, which is the maximum value on the axis. The actual highest bar in the figure is just over 1,600,000.

errors.text_span: 绿色的柱状图代表“该国全 球 确诊 数量”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly transcribes the legend for the bar chart as '该国全球确诊数量' (Global confirmed cases of that country). The actual legend text is '该日全球确诊数量' (Global confirmed cases on that day). Using 'country' contradicts 'global' and misrepresents the legend.
